_doc: Per-publisher signing policy for every image the compose files pin. scripts/verify_image_signatures.py reads this on pull requests and on main and fails closed: a keyless or key entry must verify the exact pinned digest, an image with no entry fails, an unsigned entry is reported (and warns if a signature appears). Surveyed 2026-09-06 with cosign v3.1.2 against the pinned digests.

public.ecr.aws/gravitational/teleport-di.source: Teleport signs with a key it names teleport-oci-key-2023-05.pub on goteleport.com/security but does not link. This copy is the public key recorded in the Rekor entry (logIndex 1361502545) of Teleport's own signature in its registry namespace; RSA-4096, SHA-256 of the DER starts 65dc6f41fbcac4c9. Pinning it here makes any future image signed with a different key fail.
